description: This PHP class `FileExtensionEscapingStrategy` in the Twig templating engine determines the autoescaping strategy based on the file extension of the template name. It guesses strategies like 'html', 'js', 'css', or disables escaping for 'txt' files, primarily to improve security and correctness in different types of templates.

classes.name: FileExtensionEscapingStrategy
classes.description: A class that provides a static method to determine the autoescaping strategy based on the filename extension of Twig templates.

methods.name: guess
methods.description: Guesses the autoescaping strategy ('html', 'js', 'css', or false to disable escaping) based on the provided template filename.
